subject: Medicore onboarding: invoice routing, vendor intake & PO path
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@medicore.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: next steps on buying lanes and PO flow

Hi Emily — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so everyone is aligned.

Call recap (30 min):
- Goal: confirm procurement & legal steps for Medicore pilot (3–6 month).
- Decision criteria: cost per 1K tokens, latency SLO for inference (<250ms p95), data isolation for PHI, and SOC2 evidence.
- Key stakeholders you mentioned: Ben Holloway (CFO / economic buyer), Procurement Ops (invoice/PO owner), and Security (for SOC2 review).

Open asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm the PO path (billing to your AP team) and whether Medicore requires a supplier onboarding portal entry?
2) Please confirm the economic buyer for sign-off (Ben?) and whether Finance needs a separate commercial summary for PO approval.
3) Security: any required artifacts beyond SOC2 (e.g., pen test, encryption KMS attestation)?

What we attached: Redwood-Vendor-Profile.pdf and a blank Vendor-Intake-Form.xlsx (fill and return) — these are for your Procurement team to start vendor intake.

Proposed timeline: if Procurement completes the intake this week and Ben approves the commercial terms, we can have a pilot PO issued by week of 5/17. If procurement needs more time, please flag the blocker and we’ll adapt.

If helpful, I can pull together a one-page commercial summary for Ben and a short security evidence bundle for your Security team.

Thanks — I’ll follow up mid-week if I don’t hear back.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-Vendor-Profile.pdf (summary), Vendor-Intake-Form.xlsx (please complete)

From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@medicore.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procurement@medicore.com>, Ben Holloway <ben.holloway@medicore.com>
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: next steps on buying lanes and PO flow

Hi Monica — great recap, thank you. A few clarifications from Procurement: 

- We do require a completed vendor intake (attached) and evidence for SOC2 Type II. Can you provide the latest SOC2 pdf? Also a short commercial summary for Finance (one page) that Ben can review.
- PO path: procurement@medicore.com issues the PO once intake + commercial summary + invoice instructions are confirmed.
- For pilot billing, Finance prefers Net 30 invoices issued to Medicore Health (billing address in the intake form).

Timeline: Procurement is tight for the next two weeks due to quarter close. Realistically we can target PO issuance the week of 5/17 if paperwork is returned this week. If you can route an MSA or DPA for legal review, please send to legal@medicore.com — their review window is ~7–10 business days.

Forwarding procurement form we use (attached): Vendor-Intake-Form.xlsx.

Best,
Emily
Emily Zhao
Head of Product Operations, Medicore Health
emily.zhao@medicore.com

Attachments: Vendor-Intake-Form.xlsx

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@medicore.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: next steps on buying lanes and PO flow

Thanks Emily — attached SOC2 and vendor profile. I pulled together a one-page commercial summary (below) to help Ben:

--- Commercial summary (one pager) ---
- Pilot scope: up to 50k tokens/month for inference (chat/generation) on dedicated instances; support included.
- Price: $X per 1k tokens during pilot (discount applied for pilot commit).
- Billing: monthly invoices, Net 30; invoice to AP contact listed in intake form.
- SLA: 99.5% availability for dedicated pool; latency SLOs documented in the console.
- Term: 3 months pilot, auto-extend unless explicit opt-out.

I attached: SOC2-TypeII-2026.pdf and Redwood-Vendor-Profile.pdf. Also filled the Vendor-Intake-Form.xlsx with basic contact info — see attached.

Open: Lauren (copied) — can you confirm the default invoice remit details we should include on the PO template?

Irene (copied) — if you want to pre-seed legal with a redlineable MSA I can send a DocuSign link.

—Monica

Attachments: SOC2-TypeII-2026.pdf, Redwood-Vendor-Profile.pdf, Vendor-Intake-Form.xlsx

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: legal@medicore.com, emily.zhao@medicore.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 14:36:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood legal / security artifacts and contracting path

Hi Emily / Medicore legal — copying Monica & Lauren so we're aligned on the contracting and evidence path. Quick note on what to expect from Redwood and requested next steps: 

Security & compliance artifacts:
- SOC2-TypeII-2026.pdf (attached) — primary artifact for initial review.
- Pen test summary and encryption-at-rest/KMS note available on request.

Contracting flow and timing:
1) We can issue an MSA + SOW or sign Medicore's PO-only workflow; whichever is your preferred legal model.
2) If Medicore prefers a PO-only route, please send your PO template (we attached a sample PO-template-Medicore.docx stub for alignment) and confirm any non-standard payment terms.
3) For MSA review, please upload any redlines to the DocuSign link below or send a redline to legal@medicore.com. Redwood aims to turn around vendor MSA redlines within 3 business days for standard terms.

Billing / invoice routing:
- Redwood will accept PO-issued Net 30 invoices. Please confirm AP contact and purchasable legal entity name as it should appear on the PO.

Attachments we included in this thread: SOC2-TypeII-2026.pdf, PO-template-Medicore.docx (sample), Redwood-Vendor-Profile.pdf.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/abc123/medicore-msa
Vendor portal (Medicore): https://vendor.medicore.com/portal/intake/REF-7721

Happy to hop on a quick 15m call with Medicore legal if that helps accelerate review.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

Attachments: SOC2-TypeII-2026.pdf, PO-template-Medicore.docx

From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@medicore.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procurement@medicore.com>, Ben Holloway <ben.holloway@medicore.com>, irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 09:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood legal / security artifacts and contracting path

Monica / Irene — thanks for the quick turn. Confirming the path here:
- Procurement: we'll complete the intake and aim to issue a PO by week of 5/17 (quarter close permitting).
- Finance: Ben will review the one-page commercial summary; he asked for an explicit pilot budget line to be included in the summary (Monica, can you add a line for pilot budget and expected invoice cadence?).
- Legal: we'll route any MSA redlines to the DocuSign link — legal@medicore.com will be the contact.

Regarding invoicing for the pilot: Procurement prefers a single monthly invoice; if Redwood can accept a consolidated monthly invoice with breakout by usage, that will work for AP.

Next steps for Redwood: please update the commercial summary with pilot budget and invoice cadence (monthly consolidated), confirm AP remit details on the intake form, and send any pen-test summary if available.

I'll follow up once the intake is fully complete. Appreciate the fast responses — this should make the PO window manageable.

Best,
Emily

Attachments: none
